tuition.notes: Fees for international students vary depending on the course and may include College fees

scholarships.name: Cambridge Bursary
scholarships.eligibility: UK and EU students based on household income
scholarships.amount: up to £3,500 per year (free financial support)

scholarships.name: Stormzy Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Black UK students from low-income and/or disadvantaged backgrounds

scholarships.name: F1 Scholarship (Formula 1 Engineering Scholarship)
scholarships.eligibility: UK students from underrepresented groups in Engineering

scholarships.name: Gordon Edge Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: UK students from North West England and North Wales studying science or technology

scholarships.name: Geography Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Black UK student from low-income and/or disadvantaged background

financial_aid_summary: Home fee status students can take out a government loan for tuition fees, which can be deferred until after graduation.
key_deadlines: June prior to the start of the next academic year (fee increases)
